name: Spices
overview: Scripture reveals spices as valuable commodities used for sacred, practical, and diplomatic purposes. They were essential ingredients in the holy anointing oil and incense, signifying their role in worship and temple service (Exodus 25:6; 35:8). Spices also symbolized wealth and honor, as seen in the gifts brought by the Queen of Sheba to Solomon and the presents Jacob sent to Joseph (1 Kings 10:2, 10; Genesis 43:11). Furthermore, spices were traded and transported from regions like Gilead, highlighting their significance in commerce and daily life (Genesis 37:25).
